# Per-letter room for error (generated by tools/lab/probe-thresholds.mjs)

Held-out real hands per letter: up to 30 (never used for calibration). "Counts" = the shipped verdict (js/verdict.js). Perturbations are physical (tools/synth-hand.js) and every perturbed hand is re-normalized like a live frame.
Room-for-error columns: the level where the pass rate falls below half of the unperturbed rate (— = tolerated across the whole range).
Wrong-shape columns: % of the letter's own hands that STILL count at a clearly wrong magnitude (finger bent the wrong way 60° at knuckle + middle joint; thumb 45° out / 30° in; index/middle fanned or squeezed 20°/gap). Lower is better; > 50% is a finding. (thumb) = the letter doesn't define its thumb, informational.

- P1 B: only 73% of real held-out B hands count — own pass 73%
- P0 C still counts with the thumb swung in 30° — 57% pass at 30° (base 87%)
- P1 D: only 70% of real held-out D hands count — own pass 70%
- P1 E: only 73% of real held-out E hands count — own pass 73%
- P1 N: only 70% of real held-out N hands count — own pass 70%
- P0 Q still counts with the thumb swung in 30° — 67% pass at 30° (base 70%)
- P1 Q: only 70% of real held-out Q hands count — own pass 70%
- P0 17% of real M hands count as A — M->A 17%
- P0 17% of real M hands count as E — M->E 17%
- P0 20% of real M hands count as N — M->N 20%
- P0 23% of real N hands count as M — N->M 23%
- P0 20% of real Q hands count as P — Q->P 20%
